scenes.line1: Why does .NET have two GC modes?
scenes.line2: Which is best for your app?
scenes.say: Why does dot net offer two garbage collection modes? Which one fits your app best?
Server garbage collection uses parallel threads for high throughput and scales on multi-core machines. Workstation mode runs fewer threads, keeping apps responsive for desktop users.
Pick server garbage collection for web servers and multi-core environments. Choose workstation mode for desktop apps where user interface responsiveness is key.

scenes.question: Should you use server GC for all apps?
scenes.right: No. Server GC is best for multi-core, high-load servers. Workstation GC keeps desktop apps responsive.
